title: Objectwise exactness glue for presheaf module complexes
statement: For a chain complex K of presheaf modules over R, if every objectwise evaluation of K is exact at a, then K is exact at a.

source.place: kernels and cokernels of presheaf modules are computed objectwise

proof.text: Evaluations are jointly faithful by extensionality of presheaf module morphisms. Since the category is abelian and hence balanced, JointlyFaithful.jointlyReflectsIsomorphisms gives joint reflection of isomorphisms. Apply Mathlib JointlyReflectIsomorphisms.exactAt_iff to K at a. The evaluations preserve homology because they preserve finite limits and colimits. This includes an empty indexing category.

proof_origin.place: kernels and cokernels of presheaf modules are computed objectwise; R1 compiled implementation using Mathlib evaluation reflection and the existing set resolution
